Hi Samir —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the time and for walking me through NovaHealth's ingest volume and the latency targets for your clinician-facing features. As discussed, I attached a concise pricing deck and a recommended configuration that maps to the workload you described. Quick recap: 

- Recommended configuration: 2x Dedicated instances (NVIDIA A10G), prefix caching for active sessions, conservative quantization profile to preserve medical-domain accuracy.
- Estimated monthly cost (baseline): $12k–16k — this assumes ~120M tokens/month and 95th percentile latency target of 250ms.
- Timeline to POC: ~3–4 weeks (data collection + config + smoke tests).

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) I shared the pricing deck (attached) — review and flag any parts you'd like us to expand.
2) Confirm procurement/contact for security checklist (you mentioned Jane in procurement).
3) Walk-through the deck together — I can do a 30-minute session to answer technical or pricing questions.

If helpful, here are two proposed times for a quick readout: Thu 2/26 at 10:00am PT or Fri 2/27 at 2:00pm PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple windows that do.

Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-Deck-NovaHealth-20260224.pdf
